A '''molecular scalpel''' was a model of [[scalpel]] available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was used by [[FX-769]], an [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droid]].
